The '''TaunTaun Steak Company''' was a famous [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] chain which operated locations throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including several on [[Mek-Sha]] and [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], around [[3626 BBY]]. Locations could be recognized by their distinctive logo of a [[Tauntaun/Legends|Tauntaun]] in profile slapping its tail up and down. The [[Company/Legends|company]] originated at a [[Original TaunTaun Steak Company|location]] on Mek-Sha and specialized in exotic [[meat|meats]] from all across the galaxy.<ref name="Onslaught" >''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref><ref name="Legacy" />

==History==
The TaunTaun Steak Company was founded when a shopowner received an accidental shipment of [[Tauntaun/Legends|Tauntaun]] meat and decided to open the Original TaunTaun Steak Company location, a small 8-seat diner in [[Slugfall Harbor]], [[Mek-Sha]].<ref name="Onslaught" />
